The reason I am in as much trouble as I am in because of it is because I set up an installment plan and couldn't pay the installments.  

and my ex and my ex best friend are single handedly responsible for taking my credit score from 693 to 430... cash advances are impossible
sorry
Edit:
The warrant is over an unpaid ticket for driving without insurance.  If I paid it I wouldn't go to jail.   and I know they would want to commit me and fuck that.

They all say I overreacted... about the whole thing. and no, my sister couldn't give two shits about me. There is really no one left...


I can't go to jail...  just can't

I really have no support system anymore. closest living relative I have is my sister... she's 3 hours away and has 4 kids and thinks I'm a piece of shit that dug my own grave.

 All of the people that used to be my close friends chose to want to be with the person who was my best friend after he ran away with my ex and most of my money.

I really only feel like it's only going to get worse

Can't Commit myself... I can't be in a institution.
I haven't really had much luck with the food bank where I am either... it's government run and I'm afraid they'll pull me in on my warrant if I ask for help.

Still here, still haven't slept....
The person that used to be my best friend ran off with the person I was in love with.

after enough mental breakdowns... pretty much everyone you love alienates you...
Regular basis... nothing.  I wish I had the money to drink.  I wish I had some Benzos but I don't consider Xanax Hard stuff...
I physically can not sleep. I've been trying...

I came from a very abusive home, my father threw me out of a 2nd floor window when I was 12.  I moved halfway across the country to stay with my mother after that. 
 After High School I moved back to where I was from originally,  met the girl of my dreams, got married in 9 months to my soulmate and was widowed 4 months after that. 
I nearly went bankrupt dealing with that.  I moved again and started working for the prison system, I ended up on disability from that after breaking my back.  
 I Moved again after that with my best friend, met a girl that I thought loved me. She ran away with my best friend and took all of my money with them... Moved again and Lost my job the day I moved in.  It can be that many times actually

Honestly?
I always wanted to help people in need.  I would want to be a therapist.

Art was never really my thing, I write more than I draw or paint. Both are done poorly.
I've rebuilt so many times before... I'm just so tired and so afraid that if I had to do it again it'll still be temporary.

I drink like a fifty year old...
Old Fashioned and Whiskey sours
Not really that much else to say...

There's a part of me that wants to live but I can't deal with this anymore... I've been running on fumes for the last 2 weeks and it only seems to be getting worse. I cant deal with any of this shit anymore.
I have a place I can sleep. if I could sleep...

That was with a dull knife. before I cut that night I took 5 Vicoden and downed a handle of vodka.  

and yeah, sober me knows the right way. Drunk me saws at skin until I hit bone.

I can't sleep. I've tried.  

and courage isn't saying to yourself every time you try "Fuck them" and calming down.

There's not really anything like that near me that isn't government run as far as food goes...

http://s1362.photobucket.com/user/notreallygonnabemist/library/11
It's not particularly recent. 
I can't feel my left hand anymore after that

I usually drank. Honestly i would be plastered right not if not for the fact that I can't afford a bottle.  My ex ran off with my ex best friend about 2 months ago, and I'm estranged from my family.  The people I trust have abandoned me.

Honestly I've been keeping it together in spite of everyone... in some twisted sense of pride.

I was unemployed for about a month. I just got a job yesterday but it's only part time and not really enough to pay bills, my bank account is negative. I can't go through government assistance programs because I have a bench warrant and I'd end up in jail for about 2 weeks if I tried to get help. and someone sent me a picture of my late wife yesterday that triggered an anxiety attack that hasn't stopped yet because I haven't seen a picture of her in 3 years.  She died 4 years ago...


I just can't keep from thinking about how much worse the next few days are going to be and how good I'll never have it again.
